title: limonium cyrenaicum
intro: Limonium cyrenaicum, commonly known as Cyrenaic Sea Lavender, is a plant species belonging to the family Plumbaginaceae. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving sleep quality, and exhibiting antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Limonium cyrenaicum include its use as an anti-anxiety agent and its potential in treating skin conditions due to its antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its therapeutic effects.
